description: Electric Vehicle Charging Stations is a dataset listed in Cary, NC Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Cary. This dataset contains session details from publicly available, Town-owned electric vehicle charging stations. The dataset does not include the EV charging station located at Herb Young Community Center Parking Deck (121 Wilkinson Avenue Cary, NC 27513) although it is operational. This report was pulled January 3, 2023. The dataset is updated monthly. Coverage: Cary, North Carolina. The portal files it under Environment. Its keywords are Electric Vehicle, Environment, Energy. The portal shows 20,142 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2026-06-11 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-townofcary-org-portal.
